PaddleOCR recognisers of the script pack and the text-line orientation classifier (PaddleOCR,
https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR), shipped with the OCR add-on rayopdf-ocr:
rayopdf-ocr-models/orient/ in the add-on's archives, rayopdf-ocr-models/scripts/<script>/ in the
optional script pack archives (never part of rayopdf).

Copyright PaddlePaddle Authors. The model cards declare the Apache License, Version 2.0 (its
full text is the LICENSE file of this distribution).

Source: PaddlePaddle's models on Hugging Face, pinned by revision and SHA-256 of the network file:

  PaddlePaddle/korean_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec_onnx      5c6f574b8e2230adf4287b33e736d71b9fabd28e  92f0b7785e64fc9090106a241cf4c1eb97472824558272751b88a2a4476d3a08
  PaddlePaddle/arabic_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec_onnx      14aaedcd75825982689ecf5cd64ab33ee083215a  799113ebf267fbe742deb99eb36e8d42c9ddc5291ceacf92add41b4d52a59110
  PaddlePaddle/devanagari_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec_onnx  251aec19e36739540d35e2cc943f6aa7503b98e5  cb789212ce96c69d3e74728ae4309d179281d68cb3945d0616b67cafab41c986

Modifications: the networks are converted, unchanged in their weights, to ncnn's format by pnnx
20261020 (docker/ocr_models.py); the Kannada model first from Paddle's format to ONNX by
paddle2onnx 2.1.0 with paddlepaddle 3.3.1 (docker/ocr.Dockerfile, stage `kannada`). dict.txt is
each model's character list (or the classifier's labels) from its inference.yml; config.txt
records the model, its script, its text order and settings of rayopdf-ocr.
